description: Sets the order projects are listed in inside the panel. Pass every project id of the account in the wanted order — a partial list is rejected (400). Cosmetic: the order changes nothing about delivery or about which project receives records created without one (that is always the oldest project).

confirm.description: Set to true to authorize this write/destructive call even if STATUSER_ALLOW_WRITE is not enabled in the server config. Required for one-off overrides.

project_ids.description: All project ids of the account, in the wanted order.

name: project_reorder
title: Reorder projects
